start.welcome_new: 🚀 Welcome to WordBot — your personal AI tutor! I analyse your learning style and interests to generate associations and examples tailored just for you. 🧠 Take a quick test (4 questions) — it will make learning much more effective!
start.welcome_back: 👋 Welcome back! Ready to continue learning?

style_test.question: 📖 Question 1 / 4 How do you usually memorize a new word?
options: 👁 I visualize a picture or association
👂 I say it out loud several times
⚙️ I look for logic, root or a rule
🖐 I immediately write a sentence and use it

style_test.question: 🎬 Question 2 / 4 What learning format suits you best?
options: 👁 Video lessons with diagrams and subtitles

style_test.question: 🤔 Question 3 / 4 When you get stuck on new material — what do you do?
options: 👁 I draw a diagram or find an illustration
👂 I explain it to myself aloud or listen again
⚙️ I break it down step by step using rules
🖐 I try to apply it and learn from mistakes

style_test.question: 🧩 Question 4 / 4 What does your ideal word training look like?
options: 👂 I pronounce the word and hear the correct pronunciation
🖐 A speed game or translation challenge

visual.name: Visual

audial.name: Auditory
audial.desc: 🎧 Auditory — you learn better through sound. I'll emphasize transcriptions and correct pronunciation.

logic.name: Logical
logic.desc: 🧩 Logical — structure is important to you. I'll give detailed explanations with rules and analysis.

practice.name: Practical
practice.desc: 🎮 Practical — you learn by doing. I'll offer games and practical tasks more often.
